name: even-chatgpt
description: Voice-first Even G2 client for local Codex tasks and desktop tools.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @even-chatgpt/protocol && npm run build -w @even-chatgpt/g2-client && npm run build -w @even-chatgpt/desktop-agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @even-chatgpt/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.pack:g2: npm run build -w @even-chatgpt/g2-client && npm run check:release-secrets && evenhub pack apps/g2-client/app.json apps/g2-client/dist -o even-chatgpt.ehpk
